info.longName: Jpmorgan Betabuilders U.S. Treasury Bond 3-10 Year ETF

funds_data.description: The fund seeks investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the underlying index, which measures the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated, fixed rate securities with minimum term to maturity greater than three years and less than or equal to ten years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in securities included in the underlying index.
